acceptanceCriteria: A new close operation must fail closed when the bound resource-finalization receipt is retained, blocked, or unknown; only an identity-bound deleted finalization may satisfy the close boundary.

A post-close reconciliation path may be recorded only for an already closed Work Item whose immutable close and retained finalization receipts are valid, and it must prove the exact merged-PR, branch-deleted, and worktree-removed state.
Reconciliation must be append-only and must not rewrite, replace, or delete the historical Contract, archive, verification, close, or original finalization bytes.

Reconciliation receipts must be strict, repository- and Work-Item-bound, bind the archived Contract/close/finalization digests and Runtime identity, reject malformed, foreign, stale, symlink, replay, and incomplete cleanup inputs, and be verifiable independently.
The closed-Work-Item promotion gate must accept only a valid reconciliation exception with the same bindings and exact cleanup proof; retained finalization without reconciliation remains a failure.

CLI and Runtime lifecycle tests must cover retained-close rejection, valid post-close reconciliation, tampered or foreign receipts, and exact branch/worktree cleanup; all governance decisions remain in Rust.
Tri-language workflow and command documentation must describe cleanup-before-close as the normal order and post-close reconciliation as a bounded legacy recovery path without weakening the policy.
goal: Make the canonical delivery order enforceable: new Work Items cannot close before provider branch/worktree cleanup is identity-bound and deleted, while the already-closed W312 record can be reconciled through a separately bound append-only receipt so CI promotion can prove cleanup without rewriting immutable history.
intent: 根治 close 与资源清理顺序缺口；为已关闭但 retained 的 W312 提供不改历史 bytes 的 reconciliation。
outOfScope: Reference-source inventory classification or the next file-comparison batch.
or original finalization bytes; they must remain immutable.
